prompt: A very slow push-in toward the chestnut horse's face through the gate bars. WAGES chews hay in long, lazy circles, blinks, lowers its head to pull another mouthful from the pile, then lifts it again, totally at ease. Around it the light changes in long sweeps: grey afternoon, a wash of orange evening, night with a faint floodlight glow, then flat morning grey, puddles on the turf behind filling and drying. The cloth reading WAGES and the closed gate stay exactly as they are. Sound: unhurried chewing, dripping rain, wind across the empty course, no talking. Real-looking footage of an English racecourse on a grey, wet day. Thanks.
